// diagnostic

E0103

`print` needs at least one thing to print

What

`print` needs at least one thing to print

Why

Printing nothing isn't meaningful

Fix

Add an argument to `print`, for example `print("hello")`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0103: tests/ui/fixed_constructor_placement.stderr.

Error [E0103]: `Fixed.new` needs a positive compile-time byte size
  --> tests/ui/fixed_constructor_placement.jet:6:28
    |
  6 |     fixed :: mem.Fixed.new(size: size)
    |                            ^^^^
 Why: Runtime-sized storage cannot become an inline fixed array in the current stack frame
 Fix: Use a positive literal or comptime integer, e.g. `mem.Fixed.new(size: 4096)`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0103

Error [E0103]: `Fixed.new` must directly initialize a lexical binding
  --> tests/ui/fixed_constructor_placement.jet:13:27
    |
 13 |     handles :: [mem.Fixed.new(size: 8)]
    |                           ^^^
 Why: The Fixed handle borrows inline storage whose lifetime and drop order are fixed at its declaration
 Fix: Write `fixed :: mem.Fixed.new(…)`
